title: Lusin's theorem for covector fields on ℝ^P (compact form)
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers and μ a measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra). Let A ⊆ ℝ^P be measurable with μ(A) < ∞, f : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (Covector (Euclid P) n) μ-a.e. strongly measurable, and ε > 0 real. Then there is a compact K ⊆ A with μ(A ∖ K) < ε on which f is continuous (ContinuousOn f K).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (ε : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable f μ → 0 < ε → ∃ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ A ∧ μ (A \ K) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ ContinuousOn f K
